name: lp
norm_sum_single
result.signature:
(hp : 0 < p.toReal) (f : ∀ i, E i) (s : Finset α) :
  ‖∑ i ∈ s, lp.single p i (f i)‖ ^ p.toReal = ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ ^ p.toReal
result.type:
∀ {α : Type u_3} {E : α → Type u_4} {p : ENNReal} [inst : (i : α) → NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α],
  0 < p.toReal →
    ∀ (f : (i : α) → E i) (s : Finset α), ‖∑ i ∈ s, lp.single p i (f i)‖ ^ p.toReal = ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ ^ p.toReal
result.value:
:= by
  refine (hasSum_norm hp (∑ i ∈ s, lp.single p i (f i))).unique ?_
  simp only [lp.coeFn_single, coeFn_sum, Finset.sum_apply, Finset.sum_pi_single]
  have h : ∀ i ∉ s, ‖ite (i ∈ s) (f i) 0‖ ^ p.toReal = 0 := fun i hi ↦ by simp [if_neg hi, Real.zero_rpow hp.ne']
  have h' : ∀ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ ^ p.toReal = ‖ite (i ∈ s) (f i) 0‖ ^ p.toReal :=
    by
    intro i hi
    rw [if_pos hi]
  simpa [Finset.sum_congr rfl h'] using hasSum_sum_of_ne_finset_zero h
result.informal_name: Norm of Finite Sum of Single-Element Functions in $L^p$
result.informal_description: For any extended non-negative real number $p$ with $0 < p$ and a finite set $s$ of indices, the $L^p$ norm of the sum of single-element functions $\sum_{i \in s} \text{single}_p(i, f_i)$ raised to the power $p$ equals the sum of the $L^p$ norms of the individual elements $f_i$ raised to the power $p$, i.e., $\left\|\sum_{i \in s} \text{single}_p(i, f_i)\right\|^p = \sum_{i \in s} \|f_i\|^p$.

name: Finset
sum_eq_ite
result.signature:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → M} (a : ι),
  (∀ b ∈ s, b ≠ a → f b = 0) → ∑ x ∈ s, f x = if a ∈ s then f a else 0
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → M} (a : ι),
  (∀ b ∈ s, b ≠ a → f b = 0) → ∑ x ∈ s, f x = if a ∈ s then f a else 0
result.informal_name: Sum over finite set with all but one term zero equals the non-zero term
result.informal_description: Let $ \iota $ be a type with decidable equality, $ M $ an additive commutative monoid, $ s $ a finite set of $ \iota $, $ f : \iota \to M $, and $ a : \iota $. If for all $ b \in s $, $ b \neq a $ implies $ f(b) = 0 $, then the sum $ \sum_{x \in s} f(x) $ equals $ f(a) $ if $ a \in s $, and $ 0 $ otherwise. That is, $$ \sum_{x \in s} f(x) = \begin{cases} f(a), & a \in s \\ 0, & a \notin s \end{cases} $$ when all terms except possibly $ f(a) $ are zero.

name: Fintype
sum_eq_single
result.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] {f : α → M} (a : α),
  (∀ (x : α), x ≠ a → f x = 0) → ∑ x, f x = f a
result.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] {f : α → M} (a : α),
  (∀ (x : α), x ≠ a → f x = 0) → ∑ x, f x = f a
result.informal_name: Sum Over Finite Type Equals Single Nonzero Term
result.informal_description: For any finite type $\alpha$ and additive commutative monoid $M$, if a function $f : \alpha \to M$ satisfies $f(x) = 0$ for all $x \neq a$, then the sum of $f$ over all elements of $\alpha$ is equal to $f(a)$, i.e., $\sum_{x : \alpha} f(x) = f(a)$.

name: EuclideanSpace
norm_single
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {𝕜 : Type u_3} [inst : RCLike 𝕜] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype ι] (i : ι) (a : 𝕜),
  ‖EuclideanSpace.single i a‖ = ‖a‖
result.informal_name: Norm of Single Element in Euclidean Space: $\|v\| = \|a\|$
result.informal_description: For any finite index type $\iota$ and normed field $\mathbb{K}$, and for any index $i \in \iota$ and element $a \in \mathbb{K}$, the norm of the vector in the Euclidean space $\mathbb{K}^\iota$ that has $a$ at position $i$ and zeros elsewhere is equal to the norm of $a$, i.e., $\|\text{single}_i(a)\| = \|a\|$.

name: Pi
norm_single
result.signature: [DecidableEq ι] [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (G i)] {i : ι} (y : G i) : ‖Pi.single i y‖ = ‖y‖
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {G : ι → Type u_4} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι]
  [inst_2 : (i : ι) → NormedAddCommGroup (G i)] {i : ι} (y : G i), ‖Pi.single i y‖ = ‖y‖
result.informal_name: Norm of Single Non-zero Element in Product Equals Component Norm
result.informal_description: For a finite index type $\iota$ and a family of normed additive commutative groups $\{G_i\}_{i \in \iota}$, the norm of the product element constructed by placing $y \in G_i$ at index $i$ and zero elsewhere equals the norm of $y$ in $G_i$, i.e., $\|\mathrm{single}_i(y)\| = \|y\|$.
